source.snippet: We are a subsidy and copy via ODBC part of a big database from our parent company on our own servers to work with it. The old software we are using is at the end of its life-cycle. It was never the best piece of software and we built a lot of workarounds within and around it. Now I would like to set us up for the future. I am looking for a piece of software with which I can copy tables from a database into a new one and consolidate it.

problem_statement: Business subsidiaries running legacy ETL pipelines over ODBC face end-of-life software with accumulated workarounds and no clear modern replacement that handles ODBC sources, table-level replication, and consolidation without heavy engineering lift.
target_segment: IT leads and data engineers at mid-size subsidiaries or franchise operations that sync data from a parent company database via ODBC
notes: Buyer is a corporate IT person actively shopping for replacement software — classic paid-tool replacement motion. End-of-life incumbent + workaround debt = strong willingness to pay for a clean solution. Segment likely includes franchise chains, holding companies, and subsidiaries with partial database access from parent.
